title: Shared coefficient exchange comparison diagram
statement: For an arbitrary condensed commutative coefficient ring Lambda satisfying the finiteness context, etale coefficient ring B, and two realization functors, require a four-vertex comparison between the actual ambient internal adjunction unit, square and counit factors and the images of the actual etale factors on every realized bounded constructible complex. Include factorizations of both original specified total exchange maps. The finite-discrete predicate is precisely this shared diagram specialized to the continuous-function ring of B.

source.place: The actual unit, square and counit factors and the original exchange definitions

proof.text: For every realized bounded constructible complex, require a diagram-indexed factored comparison between the actual internal chain and the mapped etale chain, including both unchanged original total maps. The mapped total uses mapHom with the mapped diagram endpoints, and mapHom_eq identifies it with the original functor map. Specialize Lambda to the continuous-function ring to obtain finiteDiscreteExchangeSteps. The record toOriginal keeps all the same vertex isomorphisms, three squares and total equations. Fully faithful restriction unit/counit and composition identities identify the old restricted internal factors with these actual ambient factors; the existing etale component formulas identify the three etale factors.

Apply FactoredComparison.nonemptyArrowIso, then rewrite both entire Arrow objects by the proved cache equations. This returns exactly the original bounded exchange arrow and original mapped etale exchange arrow, including their original endpoints.
